models_evaluated: vendor-neutral AI orchestration platform (12 AI applications)

links.outcome: Radiologist user-verification rate of AI outputs
links.effect: Verification rose from 13.9% (318/2287) at baseline to 61.1% (1778/2910) after orchestration platform plus change management; full verification of multi-task exams 62.6%; 9480 AI tasks across 12 applications.
links.quote: The overall user-verification rate increased from 13.9% (318/2287) at baseline to 61.1% (1778/2910) after implementation, while full verification of examinations containing multiple AI tasks increased to 62.6%.

links.outcome: Radiologist user-verification rate of AI outputs
links.effect: Combined structured change management (education, standardization, feedback, governance) and platform associated with verification increasing from 13.9% to 61.1%; uncontrolled pre-post, bundled intervention.
links.quote: In conclusion, a combined orchestration platform and change management strategy was associated with substantially increased AI adoption and integration into routine neuroradiology workflow.

openai.sample_unit: AI outputs assessed for user verification (2287 baseline; 2910 post-implementation)

links.outcome: Radiologist review and acceptance or rejection of AI outputs
links.effect: With combined structured change management and orchestration-platform implementation, user verification increased from 13.9% (318/2287) to 61.1% (1778/2910). The separate contribution of change management was not isolated.
links.quote: The overall user-verification rate increased from 13.9% (318/2287) at baseline to 61.1% (1778/2910) after implementation, while full verification of examinations containing multiple AI tasks increased to 62.6%.

links.outcome: AI adoption measured by user-verification rate
links.effect: Following orchestration-platform deployment with structured change management, verification increased from 13.9% (318/2287) to 61.1% (1778/2910). Separate platform effects were not isolated.
links.quote: In conclusion, a combined orchestration platform and change management strategy was associated with substantially increased AI adoption and integration into routine neuroradiology workflow.
